电竞剧本
I was once a nobody on the streets. One bottle of water changed everything. Years later, I found my way back to him. Now we stand at the top together… and everyone is wondering: what are we really to each other?
我曾经只是街头一个无名小卒。一瓶水，改变了一切。多年以后，我一路找回到他的身边。如今我们并肩站在巅峰，而所有人都在好奇：我们之间，到底是什么关系？
